Introduction
This
procedure outlines the checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases
Y1 as indicated in the above titled block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Saleh El-Sayed Saleh, and revised by 
Operation and maintenance's General Director: eng Mohamed Reda Abd El-Azez
Safety Precautions
A work 
 order must be issued, and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Transformer isolation and proper grounding on 
 both sides is required.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required,
Wear safety and healthy equipment
Tools and Equipments
Safety
 equipment "Belt, Shoes, Hemet ..., etc".
Complete tool kit, rags
Work
to be carried out
1 | Clean all cooling fans blades | OK Not OK
2 | Check 
 fan operation by turning control switch to manual | OK Not OK
3 | Painting 
 tank and accessories | OK Not OK
4 | Check oil temperature gauge | OK Not OK
5 | Check winding temperature gauge | OK Not OK
6 | Clean all the heat radiating surfaces of transformer | OK Not OK
7 | All bolted connection checked are tightens | OK Not OK
8 | Max winding
 temperature | ºC
9 | Max oil temperature | ºC
10 | Check the dielectric strength of the liquid | 30 KV
11 | Check tap changer | OK Not OK
12 | Check excitation current | OK Not OK
13 | Inspect water
 content, interfacial tension, gas content
 and neutralization number of
 insulating oil is check | OK Not OK
